adapter_evaluation.interpretation: Adding claim metadata to the prompt did not make the model reliably copy claim IDs or infer the next step and missing documents. The model should not be trusted to populate authoritative structured fields directly.
adapter_evaluation.recommended_follow_up: Prefer a hybrid architecture: derive claim ID, claim type, queue, missing-document list, next step, and mandatory human review from validated input data and deterministic rules. Restrict model use to a draft narrative summary, label it as model-generated, and require human review. Evaluate raw-model and guarded-pipeline metrics separately.

lora_qlora_training.note: Synthetic smoke fine-tuning only. Validation loss does not establish claims accuracy or suitability for real claim workflows.

implemented_capabilities: Structured output validation and mandatory human review flag
Rules baseline for routing and missing-document requests
Optional LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning script
limitations: No real insurance/claimant data is included.
The rules baseline and guarded evaluator use deterministic rules and synthetic labels; they validate implementation behavior only.
The raw QLoRA adapter has weak exact field fidelity on eight test cases; do not trust it to populate authoritative structured fields.
The guarded pipeline code has been committed but has not yet been verified in Colab.
A small synthetic test set cannot support generalization claims.
No claim approval, denial, payout, fraud, liability, or coverage decision is made.
next_step: Pull the latest main branch in Colab, run the 30-test suite and src.evaluate_guarded_pipeline, and share the output. Do not retrain the adapter for this guarded-pipeline verification.

design.source: Validated synthetic/application input plus deterministic REQUIRED_DOCUMENTS/route_claim rules
design.model_output_policy: Only a short screened summary may be used, explicitly prefixed as a model-generated draft for human verification. All other model output fields are ignored.
design.fallback: Deterministic summary if summary is malformed, too long, unsafe, or mentions a different synthetic claim ID.

guarded_hybrid_pipeline.note: Guard evaluation intentionally supplies wrong model fields and checks that deterministic structured fields remain correct. Passing confirms guard behavior only, not language-model quality.
